rows.text: This golden nectar is so sweet. I want to share it with all my friends.
rows.speaker: Altarfly

rows.text: Stealing? How do you figure that? Why, I'm golden myself, too — and as they say, like fancies like.
rows.speaker: Altarfly

rows.text: No, why am I feeling so dizzy right now? Don't tell me it's my brain growing.
rows.speaker: Altarfly

rows.text: Drinking too much always causes problems.
Problems? But how... I'm starting to feel a little delirious.
rows.speaker: Altarfly

rows.text: Wanna try some? No way, this jar's all mine... That's weird, I suddenly feel dizzy.
rows.speaker: Altarfly
